key_insight: LieDiscover jointly learns the symbolic function library and generator coefficients, enabling discovery of explicit open-form infinitesimal symmetries beyond fixed-library methods.
engineering_relevance: The approach can improve automated symmetry discovery for PDEs and other scientific models, helping downstream solvers and discovery pipelines handle more complex forms.
method: Use an encoder-decoder to generate candidate symbolic expressions.
Expand the symbolic library adaptively during optimization.
Apply reinforcement learning with step-wise rewards to explore the symbolic search space efficiently.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful recovery of open-form infinitesimal generators with high-order polynomial and transcendental terms, and improved downstream PDE solving and discovery performance.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of reinforcement-learning search and symbolic generation, which could be sensitive to search-space size and reward design.
paper_title: LieDiscover: Adaptive Symbolic Library Construction for Explicit Open-form Symmetry Discovery
